features.description: P1 Claude marker resolution, World/v1 cases and one-token isolated subscription auth probe; shared safe runner
acceptance_criteria: One Bash-3.2-compatible evidence script implements deadline/process cleanup, unique fresh-token skill/resource markers, per-arm raw streams and runid-labelled verdicts.

Claude explicit positive and absent-name negative controls pass; project, user, collision, add-dir, setting-sources, World and v1 subjects report token-discriminated origins with three fresh-session repeats for collision/World/v1.

Every Claude call uses claude-sub and claude-haiku-5-5; real and fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR auth probes request only one output token, never login/setup-token or credential writes; expected not-logged-in is recorded distinctly from instrument failure.

Every external write is confined to a new ledger-owned directory; trap removes markers and scratch, existing files/symlinks remain untouched, all touched parent listing SHA and line counts match before/after.
Controller obtains measured P1 evidence outside executor sandbox; failed controls, write-fence errors, unsafe cleanup or unresolved discovery cannot pass this milestone.
features.notes: Build the single script at design_docs/fleet-mission-evidence/iteration34/skill_resolution_spike.sh; no inference in executor sandbox.

features.description: P2 Codex native skill discovery compared with explicit pin-rooted SKILL.md and resource reads
acceptance_criteria: Codex calls use only gpt-6.1-sol, bounded deadlines, null stdin, read-only sandbox, no daemon and ephemeral sessions; explicit positive and absent-name negative controls pass.

Project .claude/skills, project .agents/skills, user .agents/skills, user .codex/skills, same-name collision and explicit-by-path arms identify origins using distinct fresh skill/resource token pairs and native-catalog/tool provenance.
Fresh synthetic CODEX_HOME is tested without creating/copying auth.json; missing authentication is recorded as a finding and never mistaken for absent discovery.

Raw stdout/stderr and verdicts identify arm plus runid; touched real-user directories are restored with matching parent listing SHA and line counts; P2 discovery result is supported by passing controls.
features.notes: Extend the same evidence script; no invented skills-config flag or model fallback. Synthetic-home auth failure alone need not invalidate controlled authenticated baseline findings.

features.description: P3 pi absolute --skill pin route for controller, automatic discovery and relative-resource provenance
acceptance_criteria: Pi uses ollama/kimi-k3:cloud, synthetic PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, read-only tools, no extensions/context, bounded deadline and null stdin; explicit positive and absent-name negative controls pass.
Absolute --skill path returns both pin skill and pin-relative resource tokens with cwd=pin and World fixture outside checkout ancestry.

Project .agents/skills discovery, same-name automatic collision, and --no-skills plus --skill interaction have distinct runid-labelled verdicts; historical driver claim is remeasured rather than assumed.
Absent real ~/.pi/agent/skills remains absent; every external marker is removed and parent listing SHA/line counts match; all controls and subjects retain raw streams.
features.notes: Extend the same evidence script. Explicit positive route does not use --no-skills; separately measure that flag's documented loading suppression.

features.description: Prepare evidence-backed Verification Log replacement rows and parked Phase 3b decision wording for controller filing
acceptance_criteria: Prepare runs/<runid>/verification-log-rows.md replacing the design doc's combined P1-P3 PENDING row with separate evidence-linked P1/P2/P3 answers, conditions, controls, auth limits and relative-resource origins; controller files the rows.

World with no project .claude/skills and v1 main-checkout cwd differing from pin receive explicit measured consequences; providers without established pin-rooted resolution are named unpinned for skills under tested conditions.
Prepare runs/<runid>/phase3b-decision.md for Mark naming measured options/limits without selecting or activating a mechanism; controller files the parked decision.

Bash syntax/static safety review passes; controller confirms every arm verdict, applicable controls passing and SHA-identical parent listings. No driver, installed skill, Go code, credentials or release-channel changes ship.
features.notes: Wording only: controller edits design_docs/planned/m-harness-mission-loop.md and files Phase 3b decision. Do not claim goal 4 or Phase 3b complete.
